notes.title: Official Korean Language Patch
notes.content:
Dear Yumemi Dreamer fans,

Thank you for all the support throughout the years. To make more people able to experience this title in their native language, we are happy to announce that we have added official Korean language support! 

We hope this can improve the overall experience, and if you have any suggestions on this update, please feel free to share them with us.

Cheers,

tags.feature: we are happy to announce that we have added official Korean language support!

notes.title: "Star Melody Yumemi Dreamer" Chapter 9 now available
notes.content:
Dear Kugado Fans,

We are pleased to announce that the ninth chapter of "Star Melody Yumemi Dreamer" is available today, March 10th, 2022.

[b]■Chapter 9: Sun, Sand, and Sleepovers! [/b] 
Chapter 8 will be available for purchase for [b]330 yen[/b] for one week from today's launch.
Wonder what will happen after the demo...? Take this chance to grab the new episode If you're curious about the rest of the story!

[b]■Season Pass[/b]
The Season Pass has a permanent "10% off" discount, so you can save more money than if you purchase one chapter per week!

After the purchase, the latest episodes will be automatically added to the base game itself, so you can enjoy "Star Melody Yumemi Dreamer" effortlessly.

Chapter 1 and 2 are currently available as a free demo version, so if you are interested in the game, please take the opportunity to give it a try.
